mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that typically precede higher corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% (monthly).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year inflation acceleration in CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0% signals heightened inflation concerns that prompt market anticipation of Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeding 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals synchronized labor market tightening and manufacturing expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE declines by more than 0.2 percentage points and INDPRO rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an economic slowdown that may lead to a Fed pause or cut, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) level below 1,000.0 (thousands of units) indicates a weakening housing market, a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST below 1000.0 (thousands of units).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level below 100.0 (index, 2017=100) signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.05 percentage points from the prior month signals an early monetary tightening, causing short-term negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the policy shift.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.05% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly annualized GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeding 3.0% indicates robust economic expansion that supports higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 annualized growth exceeding 3.0%.
